reviews.title: Phenomenal Microphone
reviews.comment: This mic is perfect for podcasting or streaming. The software is very intuitive and the Aphex processing does wonders for your voice. This mic will give you a broadcast voice and while it isnt a perfect mic for a somewhat noisy room, it holds its own and keeps the focus on your voice.
reviews.author: Randall B Clark
